episodes.synopsis:
The twin boys Migi and Dali live in an orphanage until one day they are adopted by a wealthy and gentle elderly couple, the Sonoyamas.

However, they are not taken in as the two boys 'Migi' and 'Dali,' but rather as a single boy named 'Hitori Sonoyama.' While hiding their true identities and pretending to be Hitori Sonoyama, they hatch a plan to win over the Sonoyamas.

Their scheme is highly successful; within just a day, they won the favor of the elderly couple. Inside the tent in their room, the two share a sly smile.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis:
Migi and Dali have been fully accepted as members of the Sonoyama family.

They behave just like real parent and child, but the twins notice that Mom and Dad are acting somewhat distant.

Suspecting that the Sonoyama couple might be hiding something, the two discreetly begin to search the house and stumble upon an unexpected secret of the couple.

Migi and Dali are shocked, wondering if they have been deceived. However, determined not to let things end this way, they execute a plan to retaliate against the Sonoyamas.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis:
To uncover the truth behind their mother's death, Migi and Dali finally begin to take serious action.

Their clue is the memory of the room they lived in with their mother when they were young. They remember the dimly lit space under the bed and the wallpaper patterned wih daphnia.

In order to locate the room, the twins come up with a plan to be invited over as friends to different houses.

They promptly join the Boy Scouts to make friends, but the scouts offer their friendship on one condition.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: The housemaid Micchan tells Migi and Dali that the Ichijo family has a room with water flea wallpaper. They begin attending school to befriend Eiji, the son of the Ichijo family. However, to get close to Eiji, they need to score well on tests and join a top class. The two start studying diligently to boost their grades, but unexpectedly, Migi falls head over heels for a certain female student in the library.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: After achieving first place in the test, the Sonoyama family was invited to the suspicious Ichijo residence. Dali, seeing this as an opportunity, thoroughly searches the Ichijo house. However, she falls into Eiji's trap, and Migi ends up being captured.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: Dali continues to search the Ichijo house. Migi, by perfectly playing the role of an infant, tries to draw out the secrets of the Ichijo family.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: "It was Eiji who killed our mother!?" To confirm the truth, Dali disguises herself as Sali and begins to approach Eiji alone.
episodes.title: Non era un fantasma

episodes.synopsis: Shocked to discover that Sali's true identity was Dali, Migi flees to Akiyama's house to escape. Dali comes to bring Migi back for revenge, but Migi decides to live freely, not bound by revenge.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Why did Eiji help him? To find out, Migi disguises herself as Sally and visits Eiji's house. Eiji shows Sally (Migi) around the attic and tells her about Reiko's and Eiji's secret, and how it has put Hitori in danger. However, Reiko has also seen them talking! Migi recoils from Reiko's strange aura. At that moment, Migi witnesses Reiko's terrifying true nature.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: Framed as murderers by Reiko, Migi and Dali find themselves unable to reveal themselves and decide to seek help from Akiyama.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: Reiko, cornered by Migi and Dali, finally begins to speak about Metry, the mother of Migi and Dali. It turns out to be the story of their birth as well...
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: Migi and Dali, along with others, are trapped in a confinement room. Gradually, smoke from the fire started by Eiji begins to drift into the room.
episodes.title: Episodio 12

episodes.synopsis: The Ichijo house was burned down, and the incident was resolved, gradually bringing life back to normal. Migi and Dali were supposed to return to their usual lives as well, but there was one difference.
episodes.title: Episodio 13

info.synopsis: Dopo aver desiderato un figlio per anni, una ricca coppia di mezza età riesce finalmente ad adottare un ragazzo, il tredicenne Hitori. La casa è lussuosa, i genitori premurosi e il cibo delizioso: il ragazzo, tuttavia, sembra voler mantenere a tutti i costi uno strano segreto proprio per proteggere il quadretto da famiglia perfetta. Chi è in realtà Hitori? O meglio, chi sono...?
info.title: Migi & Dali

episodes.synopsis: Edo has been suffering from crimes led by Tanbei of Chigashira. Heizo is faced with a mystery when jailed Kumehachi claims that he is not the real Tanbei. Kumehachi remembers Tanbei as a boss who abides by the three articles of a true thief. Heizo took Kumehachi's word and ordered him to find the real Tanbei.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Heizo finds out about the continuous incidents happening at the Kakunosuke Hattori residence and as he heads out, he reunites with Samanosuke Kishii.Hearing that the evil Kakunosuke is scheming a robbery, he surrounds the estate and arrests the clan. But there he finds Ofusa, the first love of both Heizo and Samanosuke...
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: One night, Heizo gets attacked by a ruffian. Hanshiro Kaneko was searching to avenge his father and became an assassin. His last job was to assassinate Heizo and was set to quit the life of an assassin. Hanshiro attacked Heizo who was visiting the boathouse, however...
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Heizo got a visit from Omasa of Nusubito Sake Shop. Now a thief, Omasa left a rough and brutal clan to serve as Heizo's spy. Then Genpachi, a clan member, appears and reports to her that they will carry out the robbery the day after tomorrow and leaves. Omasa follows Genpachi but gets kidnapped on the way...
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: A burglary occurred at the dry-goods wholesaler where 15 people were slaughtered. It was detected as the doing of Shugoro of Hakabi's clan. Omasa tells Chugo that they can use the money given by her regular customer, not knowing he is in fact Shugoro of Hakabi.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: Heizo becomes accompanied by a thief named Zenpachi of Isa. He admired Heizo's ability and character and approached him with the idea to rob the estate of the notorious Ichigoro Masuya. On the day of the burglary, they escape with the cashbox. Zenpachi goes back inside claiming that he dropped the book of "Secret Theft Tactics."
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: Arson Theft Control struggled to investigate Gohei Ishikawa, a member of a notorious clan led by Shinbei the Viper. As a child, he was abused by his step-father. While Heizo was in Kyoto, the abuse escalated and led to him stabbing his step-father to death. He ran away from Edo and resented Onihei for the incident.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Heizo realized his pipe, a valuable keep-sake of his father, was gone. After patrolling the city, he stepped into a boat where Tomogoro, the boatman was smoking with the very pipe that was stolen. Tomogoro proudly revealed how he stole Heizo's pipe to frustrate the feared "Onihei" of Edo.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Back in the day when young Heizo used to call himself Tetsusaburo, a skilled man named Jyubei Matsuoka entered the Takasugi Dojo during his lessons. Later, Heizo returns home where his father's legal wife, Hatsu, calls him an illegitimate child. Dispirited, Heizo accepts an assignment to rob with his best friend, Samanosuke.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: Wasuke of Dojo returns to Asakusa and reunites with Magokichi. His son Isotaro was Wasuke's biological child. But Isotaro took his own life after his boss at Ozuya framed him for a crime. Both Magokichi and his wife Ohiro committed suicide by throwing themselves in the water. To avenge them, Wasuke decides to rob Ozuya...
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: While Heizo was out, Hisae received a letter which read, "Tomorrow at four, at tea shop Yoshinoya by the Gokokuji gates..." The sender was the man of the past, Kanshiro Kondo. Hisae goes to the place alone. Kanshiro tells her, "don't be surprised when you get back."
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: Koyanagi saved a woman from throwing herself along with her child in the water. They were the wife and child of Matahachi of Shishidome who was arrested by Koyanagi. Koyanagi was frustrated that he couldn't catch Monzaburo of Amabata and lets Matahachi out with his family in exchange for information on Monzaburo's whereabouts.
episodes.title: Episodio 12

episodes.synopsis: A robbery at Shop Yamadaya left 17 people dead. From the "Kitsunebi" note left at the scene, it was clear that it was by the Kitsunebi clan. However, its leader has passed and his successor is a former lover of Omasa. As a former member of Kitsunebi, Omasa suspects that they were framed by a criminal.
episodes.title: Episodio 13

info.synopsis: Per mantenere la pace ad Edo sono necessarie le arti e la spada di un "demone", solo un "Oni" può combattere contro le forse malvagie! Heizou Hasegawa, è un personaggio storico realmente esistito e conosciuto come il Demone Heizu; egli comandava le forze preposte a mantenere l'ordine in città e nella regione dal 1783. Le sue gesta si confusero tra storia e leggenda, mentre diede la caccia ai peggiori criminali dell'epoca...
info.title: Onihei

episodes.synopsis: After defeating Sylvia at the Crimson Demon Village, Kazuma and his party look forward to receiving a reward that could mean freedom from the grind of having to fulfill quests. Kazuma himself, however, seems to be having nightmares and bouts of paranoia.
episodes.title: Sia benedetto questo futuro radioso!

episodes.synopsis: Kazuma and the gang receive a letter from Princess Iris. She wants to share a meal with them while hearing about their adventures. While Kazuma is giddy with wonderment of her beauty, Darkness is terrified of heads rolling in the event of any rudeness.
episodes.title: Un sorriso per questa ragazza cupa!

episodes.synopsis: What started as dinner at Darkness's mansion with Princess Iris has turned into Kazuma being dragged back to the castle! Rain explains the situation, and Kazuma agrees to keep Iris company. His wild stories leave the princess with stars in her eyes.
episodes.title: Una rieducazione per questa brillante ragazzina!

episodes.synopsis: Kazuma thinks of a way to stay in the capital for Iris's sake, and declares that he will capture the thief who's causing a stir in the streets! Since the thief targets nobles with bad behavior, Kazuma and his friends decide to stay at Alderp's mansion.
episodes.title: La vendetta su questo affascinante ladro!

episodes.synopsis: The Devil King's army attack alarm rings in the royal capital! The adventurer's guild calls on high-level adventurers to join the battle. Having failed to capture the thief at Alderp's mansion, Kazuma joins the fight in order to redeem his reputation.
episodes.title: Una rieducazione per questa ragazzina vivace!

episodes.synopsis: Chris tells Kazuma that the necklace he and Iris swapped bodies with is a sacred treasure, and it is dangerous and can threaten lives depending on its use. Princess Iris is in danger! Two robbers dressed in black sneak into the royal castle at night!
episodes.title: Un addio a questo stile di vita lussuoso!

episodes.synopsis: Kazuma and his friends return to Axel and receive 300 million eris as a reward for subjugating Sylvia, an executive of the Devil King's army. Kazuma and Aqua go to high-end restaurants, and Aqua enjoys her long-awaited life as a celebrity.
episodes.title: Riposo per questo avventuriero emergente!

episodes.synopsis: Kazuma and the gang fail to defeat the hydra in the lake near Axel. The gang hopes to rely on knights from the capital, but they've been delayed due to a bandit disturbance for which a bounty has been issued. Darkness, however, is obsessed with the hydra.
episodes.title: Un eterno riposo per il padrone di questo lago!

episodes.synopsis: Darkness departs the mansion leaving behind a note. Not satisfied by a single note, Kazuma, Aqua, and Megumin protest in front of the Dustiness manor but are rudely turned away. Kazuma, frustrated with everything, is approached by Dust who needs his help.
episodes.title: Una conversazione per questa fuga!

episodes.synopsis: Darkness's wedding to Aldarp is imminent. Despite Aqua's and Megumin's pleas, Kazuma has no intention of intervening. Vanir then visits the mansion and reveals a shocking secret to Kazuma.
episodes.title: Una benedizione per questa sposa egoista!

episodes.synopsis: Kazuma has crashed Darkness's wedding to Aldarp and pays him the two billion eris he says he's owed. Aqua and Kazuma try to make off with Darkness but Aldarp won't relinquish her so easily and orders his guards to stop their escape.
episodes.title: Le benedizioni di Dio per questi giorni immutabili!

info.synopsis: Anno sette del Periodo Kowa, nell'ex Blocco di Hokkaido occupato dall'Impero della Neo-Britannia vivono due fratelli, noti come i Mercenari Anonimi. Il maggiore, Ash, vanta eccellenti doti atletiche e abilità di controllo dei Knightmare Frame, mentre il minore, Rozé, ha le idee chiare e supervisiona la raccolta delle informazioni e la definizione delle strategie. Grazie a un impenetrabile muro di energia, il Muro di Situmpe, il 100° imperatore, Callis al Britannia, ostacola da quattro anni il piano di liberazione dei Cavalieri Neri per far ripiombare il mondo nel caos, servendosi dell'aiuto del suo servitore Norland e dei suoi Cavalieri Einberg. Rozé e Ash, insieme alla resistenza delle Sette Stelle Splendenti, vengono ingaggiati per affrontare l'Impero e liberare la principessa Sakuya.

episodes.synopsis: Il professor Saotome è alla ricerca di potenziali piloti per il Getter Robo che lo assistano nella guerra contro i demoni. Il suo primo candidato è un giovane attaccabrighe di Tokyo, Ryoma Nagare, che però non sembra subito disposto a collaborare.
episodes.title: Ryoma è qui

episodes.synopsis: Il terrorista Hayato Jin fa irruzione nel Ministero della Difesa dove trova documenti segreti sull’impiego di un’arma speciale. Decide così di prendere d’assalto il laboratorio del Professor Saotome per impossessarsene.
episodes.title: Arriva Hayato

episodes.synopsis: Il monaco Benkei Musashibo si allena in pratiche ascetiche, ma un giorno i suoi fratelli e il suo maestro si trasformano in demoni e mirano alla spada in suo possesso. Ryoma è mandato dal professor Saotome a cercare il monaco, ma si schianta in mezzo ai monti.
episodes.title: Musashibo Benkei

episodes.synopsis: Il laboratorio è attaccato da un misterioso mostro rampicante con radici esplosive che viene apparentemente sconfitto con facilità dal Getter Robo. I piloti faticano ancora a cooperare tra loro per incompatibilità caratteriali.
episodes.title: Tre animali a briglie sciolte

episodes.synopsis: Uno dei demoni giganti affrontato dal Getter Robo scompare entrando in un vortice di luce. Ryoma vuole sapere dove fuggano sempre i demoni e decide di seguire il consiglio del professor Saotome e di gettarsi al loro inseguimento.
episodes.title: Fuochi fatui

episodes.synopsis: Dopo essere stati trascinati nel vortice di luce, Ryoma, Benkei e Hayato si risvegliano nel periodo Heian, dove Ryoma fa la conoscenza del famoso comandante Minamoto no Raiko.
episodes.title: Il palazzo dei demoni

episodes.synopsis: Hayato e Benkei riesumano il Getter Robo dalla montagna sotto cui era sepolto, ma senza Ryoma il robot non riesce a sprigionare la sua totale forza.
episodes.title: L’Onmyoji

episodes.synopsis: Il Getter Robot affronta i demoni giganti evocati da Abe no Seimei. Nel frattempo, Raiko sferra un assalto all’oscura capitale Heian, portando con sé le truppe a bordo delle sue aeronavi.
episodes.title: Scontro

episodes.synopsis: Sono passati tre anni da quando il Getter è scomparso nel lago Biwa e, quando fa il suo ritorno improvviso, i membri del laboratorio del Professor Saotome sono scossi e lo attaccano credendolo un nemico.
episodes.title: La scena dell'inferno

episodes.synopsis: Dopo la visione infernale del futuro, Ryoma torna a Tokyo dove incontra vecchie conoscenze. Seimei, però, appare proprio nella città alla guida di un demone gigantesco e inizia a causare distruzione ovunque.
episodes.title: Lupo solitario

episodes.synopsis: Continua la battaglia del Getter Robo contro Abe no Seimei, ma Benkei inizia a nutrire seri dubbi sul fatto che il Getter Robo sia la salvezza dell’umanità. All’improvviso, nei cieli sopra il laboratorio quattro misteriose figure fanno la loro apparizione.
episodes.title: Così soffia il vento divino

episodes.synopsis: I Quattro Re Celesti continuano ad attaccare il laboratorio, ma il Professor Saotome invia i prototipi dei Getter ad affrontarli. Intanto, Ryoma e i suoi compagni devono liberare il Getter Robo dalle macerie per partecipare allo scontro finale.
episodes.title: Terra e cielo

episodes.synopsis: Il Getter Robo continua la battaglia contro i Quattro Re Celesti grazie all’energia ricevuta dal professor Saotome, ma Tamonten si getta nelle profondità del laboratorio, dove incredibilmente c’è un varco che conduce a un’altra realtà spaziotemporale.
episodes.title: Ultimo episodio

info.synopsis: All’insaputa dei più, l’umanità è prossima all’estinzione. La minaccia consiste negli Oni, che più che mai si stanno dimostrando un pericolo e che stanno sempre più acquistando forza. Ormai anche i robot di classe Getter, prodotti in serie, sembrano impotenti e decisamente inferiori agli avversari. L’unica speranza risiede in un nuovo modello, ormai quasi completato, del Getter, che tuttavia necessita di un equipaggio all’altezza, formato da persone fuori dal comune, che è necessario selezionale e arruolare il prima possibile. Il tempo, ormai, è un lusso che non si può sprecare in alcuno modo.

episodes.synopsis: After an asteroid crashes onto the planet of Expel, strange things begin to happen. Natural disasters happen with greater frequency and monsters begin to appear. A legend states that a warrior will come to save their planet with a sword of light. Far away, on the planet of Milocinia, the small party from the space ship Calnus, under command of Ronixis J. Kenni, investigates a large black globe that has been the cause of some disturbances. While doing so, Claude C. Kenni, son of Ronixis, is pulled into some type of device and sent to Expel, where he meets Rena Lanford, saving her from being attacked. She mistakes the weapon he uses, a phase pistol, for the sword of light and believes that Claude is the warrior that will save them.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: After saving her life, Rena takes Claude to her village, Arlia, where she has him wait at the church for her to get the town elder. As he waits, he sees that the church's stained gass windows tell the story of the warrior of light. Rena comes to get Claude soon and takes him back to her house. He has dinner then Rena shows him to his room. As they sit on his bed, it begins to rain and she begins to stare at him and mutters that she "has been waiting all this time". Embarrased, Rena leaves and Claude decides to take a nap. Claude dreams that his father comes to save him, but refuses to help. He tells Claude that the only one that can save him now is himself. Claude wakes to find someone in his room. This person attacks, but Claude just dodges. Rena tells the man to stop. It is the town elder, Regis, that has attacked Claude, but he tells Claude that he had to be sure that Rena was right about Claude being the Warrior of Light, and now he is. Regis tells Claude more about the disasters that have ben happening on Expel and about what his mission is. Claude, however, insists that he is not the Warrior of Light. He just wants to go home. Not being able to change Claude's mind, the elder tells Claude that he can stay at his house for the night then should go to Salva, a town to the north, where he can find more information. The elder also gives Claude a sword with which he can protect himself. The next day in Salva Claude saves a girl named Yuki from several thugs. She tells him that they work for the mayor's son, Alen, who is childhood crush of Rena. Alen came through earlier saying that he and Rena would be married that day. Claude runs back to Arlia, but on the way meets Alen, who has kidnapped Rena and is taking her back to his mansion in Salva. Rena's crecent moon hairpiece falls off near Claude and he takes it and goes to save Rena.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Claude arrives at Alen's house, but finds that the front door is locked. Yuki appears from behind the house and shows his another way in. In the house, Alen explains to a tied up Rena that he is not the same man he was before. He holds out his and a purple stone appears, floating just above his palm. Alen has been reborn through the power of the stone. Alen begins the ceremony, but Claude enters then and tells him to stop. Alen explains that he and Rena have loved each other since childhood; but when he asks, Rena won't look at him. He turns her head, but all he sees in her eyes is pitty.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Rena and Claude decide to visit the king in Cross, who tells them that the battles with the monsters on the continent of El, where the Sorcery Globe landed, are still going on. After making sure they will not change their mind, the king gives them a passport to go. Back outside, they meet Celine Jules as she is being attacked, though she does more damage to the attackers than they to her. But, because of him stepping in, Celine makes Claude her bodyguard. Celine tells them that she is a treasure hunter and is searching for the treasure of Cross Cave and eventually talks them into making a detour to the cave while on their way to El; although the cave is in the wrong direction. After searching the cave and getting lost, thanks to a false map that Celine had, they stumble onto a chamber with the treasure. It turns out to be an old book written in a language that they do not know. After coming back out of the cave, Celine tells them that she is going with them.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Rena, Claude, and Celine discover a sign pointing them in the direction of a town called Mars. Celnie tells them that this town is a town of Heraldic sorcerers like her. Then Celine notices a bog crawling on her hand and runs away. That is when Claude and Rena hear someone scream. They go see what the trouble is and find some bandits trying to steal a stagecoach full of children. While saving the children and their teacher, Rena and Claude meet an old friend of Rena's named Dias. Rena and Dias grew up in Arlia before he left and became a great swordsman. After making their way to the town of Mars, the town elder and the teacher thank them for saving the children. They tell Claude, Rena, and Dias that the bandits wanted to capture the children and use them as hostages to get the Book of Seals, which is a book filled with Heraldic secrets and is never permitted to leave the town. They ask Claude and Dias to help them protect the town. Claude accepts, as does Dias. Dias, however, tells them that he will be enough then leaves. Rena follows and tells Dias that she thinks Claude is the Warrior of Light and that they are going to El to see the Sorcery Globe. She asks Dias to help Claude. The next day, Claude finds Dias in the forrest and goes to apoligize, but Dias attacks him using only his left hand, pointing out his weeknesses. After beating Claude senseless, he talls Claude that he's too weak to protect Rena. Claude gets up and attachks Dias this time, forcing Dias to use his right hand. This makes Dias mad and he uses Kuuhazan to defeat Claude. After getting Claude back to his room in Mars, Rena uses her powers to heal Claude. It's not long after that the town is attacked. Dias is lured away by some of the bandits, but is forced to face another enemy. While he fights and defeats them, the town elder tells the people there that this is the time to move the book to a safer location. But, Celine and Rena reveal that the real elder was attacked and this man is an imposter
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: Because of the dragons attached to Ashton's back, Ashton decides to join Claude's gang in search of the Tears of the King to remove the dragon, Gyoro and Ururun behind his back.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: The gang decides to put a hold on finding the Tears of the King and help a beautiful woman named Opera to look for her long-lost boyfriend in the Mountain Palace.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: After finding out that the Tears of the King will kill Gyoro and Ururun, Ashton must decide whether to get riid of them and return to normal or stay it that way for the rest of his live.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: The gang reaches Harley Town where Ashton and Rena have their own mini adventure in this town.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: After Claude encounter a maiden ghost and a pirate who dresses up in seaweeds, the gang decides to solve both mysteries to bring back peace to Herlie Town.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: The gang arrived at Linga and met an inventor girl, Precis. Another mini adventure for Ashton and Precis to find Elanor's ribbon.
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: As Claude and the gang search for the Metoks they find out Precis is in trouble. When they go to her aid they get attacked by some strange vines. As it turns out, the Precis they saved is not even real. If the Precis they is an imposter then where is the real Precis?
episodes.title: Episodio 12

episodes.synopsis: In order to get into Raquel Castle and see Professor Leon, someone in the group must win the tournament in the town. Claude refuses but Ashton decides he will join. Can Ashton win the tournament?
episodes.title: Episodio 13

episodes.synopsis: Rena goes to look for Dias and witnesses him attack someone. She then goes to find Dias to see what is going on, but Dias will not tell her anything. The next day Dias easily defeats his opponent while Ashton not only knocks out his opponet but himself as well. With Claude worried about Rena he nearly loses his match if Rena had not called out to him. Is everything alright between the two?
episodes.title: Episodio 15

episodes.synopsis: As Claude and Dias continue their battle Dias explains that there will be an assasination attempt on the king by Gaizel, but the real Gaizel was killed and a monster has taken his place. Celine and Ashton break into the castle and find that the guards and not real. They are monsters in disguise. After they defeat them all they rescue Leon who is actually a little boy. With Gaizel's plan revealed he turns into his true form. Can Dias and Claude defeat him before he kills the king?
episodes.title: Episodio 16

episodes.synopsis: Claude and Leon go to find some energy stones to power Leon's new invention. They run into a monster who begins to attack them and all looks grim until Precis and the gang show up and defeat the monster. With this done they all head to the ruins Leon and Claude were going to to find the energy stones.
episodes.title: Episodio 17

episodes.synopsis: After Leon sends several homing pigeons requesting soldiers to come help move the Lacur Hope. Claude and the others arrive at the Haynes Fortress and find the soldiers watching a concert. Before they can leave they are arrested for espionage.
episodes.title: Episodio 18

episodes.synopsis: Dias returns alone from his journey to L continent. Commander Harvest conspires with the monster to disable the Lacur Hope.
episodes.title: Episodio 19

episodes.synopsis: A massive storm at sea sinks the ship and separates everyone. Claude & Leon wash up on an island and are soon attacked.
episodes.title: Episodio 20

episodes.synopsis: Rena, Ashton and Celine are together and are searching for Claude & Leon. Meanwhile, Claude & Leon try to fix the Lacur Hope.
episodes.title: Episodio 21

episodes.synopsis: The Lacur Hope is broken beyond repair, Opera has disappeared and someone has stolen the energy stone. But it doesn't make Claude & the gang lose hope.
episodes.title: Episodio 22

episodes.synopsis: Claude & the others reach the Sorcery Globe. While fighting off the robots and monsters protecting it, Claude & the gang are rescued by Opera & Ernest in their spaceship. They load the Lacur Hope on the ship and attack the Globe.
episodes.title: Episodio 23

episodes.synopsis: The Black Moon has risen. The Sorcery Globe begins is attack and everyone is forced to flee. While hiding in a cave, Claude gets a message from his father. After Claude tells his father to leave, the gang prepares for an all out assault on the Globe.
episodes.title: Episodio 24

episodes.synopsis: The assault on the Globe begins. While Ashton and Celine keep the monsters and robots at bay, Claude & Rena discover the truth of the Globe and her origins.
episodes.title: Episodio 25

episodes.synopsis: Claude and his friends travel inside the Sorcery Globe. Claude with the help of everyone destroys the Sorcery Globe, but it does not end, the black moon reappears after the destruction of the Sorcery Globe. Gene freezes time and allows Claude and everyone else to use a teleporter to battle the enemy that threatens the world (Expel). But this is the last episode of Star Ocean EX, as it was canceled.
episodes.title: Episodio 26

episodes.title: Abbracciando il faro dell'ambizione: parte 3

episodes.synopsis: Le condizioni per lanciare il potentissimo attacco di Psyger-0 sono state quasi tutte soddisfatte. In attesa del completamento di un lungo incantamento, i suoi compagni d'avventura dovranno tenere a bada Lykaon. Ma le sorprese non sono ancora finite...

episodes.synopsis: Sconfitti l'ombra di Lykaon e il boss di zona, Sunraku arriva a Quindicia per presenziare all'incontro con Rust e Mold.
episodes.title: Abbracciando il faro dell'ambizione, parte 5

episodes.synopsis: 猿楽製薬での大規模事故と失踪した番場宗介を追うジャーナリスト・川上。ある時、事故に関わる情報を掴んだ川上は空港を訪れていた。そこで旅客機から乗客全員が消失する怪事件に遭遇。唯一生き残ったCAが語った真相とは…？
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: 豪雨の中、岬を走る寝台列車を海から来た何かが襲う。運転手を失い、制御不能となった列車は、崖に突き進む。番場を護送中の岩崎刑事は事故を免れるため、やむを得ず協力を求めるが…。
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: 恋人・ユミカと山奥にある秘湯を訪れたタツヤ。しかしユミカは忽然と姿を消してしまう。旅館の従業員達は、最初からタツヤ一人だったと口をそろえるが…。秘湯に潜む呪われた儀式を目撃する…！
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: 猿楽本社に連行された番場は、極秘任務に同行させられる。同社の兵器化実験の失敗で奇獣が氾濫した町に潜入、研究チームの甲斐博士を救出しようとするが、奇獣の群れに取り囲まれてしまう…！
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: 突然鳴り響いた謎の音に、番場は身動きを封じられてしまう。苦しむ番場、その姿をあざ笑うかのように一人の少女現れる。一方、木村は一連の騒動の背後で蠢く思惑に気がつき、回避しようとするが…！
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: 番場を襲った事件の真相が明らかになる。それは木村も知り得ない新たな奇獣計画の一部だった。そんな中さらなる奇獣事件が発生。猿楽研究員・秋良とその娘・莉央が襲われてしまう…！
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: 霧子は、猿楽の研究所より脱走したある貴重な奇獣を追っていた。その奇獣は番場宗介と同じく、人間の知性を残したまま、影鰐の能力を備えているという。 ついに発見し確保したのだが…！
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: 番場宗介は、猿楽製薬に囚われていた。検体として投薬を繰り返される中、謎の夢を見る。それは影鰐に関わるある記憶だった。番場は、影鰐を生み出した者、影鰐に喰われた者、そして一人生き残った者を目撃する！
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: 番場は、本間局長率いるチームの研究施設に運び込まれていた。そこで行われるのは、奇獣や番場を利用した新たな生物兵器の生成、そしてビジネス――。本間に体の自由を奪われ、兵器生成の検体に組み込まれる番場。脱出不可能の危機が迫る…!?
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: 木村の協力により猿楽研究施設を抜け出した番場は影鰐を追う。その頃、ナギは奇獣の気配を辿り、ある廃墟の町に辿り着いた。一人の少女と一夜をともにすることになったのだが…。奇獣と母を失った記憶、二つの悪夢がナギに襲いかかる…！
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: 番場と木村は雲南省の廃村にたどり着く。そこはかつて蟲毒の儀式が行われ、影鰐が潜む忌まわしき場所。意を決する番場の前に、鋭く突き刺さる槍、いつの間にか忍び寄る影鰐。ついに死闘の幕があける…！
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: 追い詰められた影鰐の力は悍ましいほど強大だった。だが番場の目は生きていた。クローンを解放し、身を奇獣化させながら、最後の闘いに挑む番場。脈々と続く負の連鎖、そして復讐、番場は影鰐と人間の因縁を断ち切ることはできるのか…!?
episodes.title: Episodio 12

episodes.synopsis: 木村のねらいは全ての始祖である影鰐の力を手にすることだった。圧倒的な力を手に入れ、自らを選ばれし者と称する木村に対し、番場とナギは為す術もない。過ちの代償は受け継がれて行く。物語の終わりと共に――。
episodes.title: Episodio 13

episodes.synopsis:
In Bastille, France, the treasure of the Bourbon Dynasty was stacked in a truck and stolen. Thinking it was undoubtedly Lupin's doing, Zenigata and the French police pursue the truck. But, the criminal was actually an unheard-of woman. Then, the true Lupin appears. Lupin successfully steals the truckload of treasure from the woman but is then mysteriously kidnapped.
Malchovich is the man who kidnapped Lupin. Fujiko is also caught and kept hostage while trying to steal the worldwide famous jewel "Bull's Eye". In order to rescue Fujiko, Lupin, along with reluctant Jigen and Goemon, tries to steal Bull's Eye from the Grand Bateau, the French museum renowned for having the greatest security in the world. Everything starts from here!
Female thief Becky, scoundrel Malchovich, and Lupin... Ambition, human relations... Each secret becomes gradually clear during the scramble for the Bull's Eye. The series' highest spectacle romance unfolds, and France is the stage.

episodes.synopsis: Aspiring young Rider Lute and friends go in search of a Monstie Egg on the eve of the Kinship Rite. A search that takes them into dangerous territory.
episodes.title: The Power of Bonds

episodes.synopsis: It's Kinship Rite time! Lilia and Cheval are uncertain about their futures, while an unexpected attack on Hakum Village sends its Riders scrambling.
episodes.title: A Monstie Is Born!

episodes.synopsis: A Hunter is headed for secretive Hakum Village. He's sure to have his own way of dealing with all these monsters showing up where they don't belong...
episodes.title: Absolute Power

episodes.synopsis: Chief Omna sends the apprentice Riders off in search of the Waterfall of Trials. A visitor to Hakum Village gives Lilia inspiration for her future.
episodes.title: The Kinship Rite

episodes.synopsis: Hakum Village revives the beloved Monstie Races for their four newest Riders, but Lute could still use a lot more practice piloting his powerful pal.
episodes.title: Off to the Monstie Races

episodes.synopsis: Lute and friends dream about what they'd buy with the proceeds from a rare and valuable golden Gargwa egg, and Cheval decides to try hunting one down.
episodes.title: Quest for the Golden Egg

episodes.synopsis: The mischievous twins Den-Den and Lin-Lin are stirring up trouble in Hakum Village--and run into trouble of their own in the forboding woods at night.
episodes.title: Like Mom Used to Make

episodes.synopsis: Ms. Pink the traveling merchant stops by the village, and Navirou falls hard for her Felyne assistant Mocha. How far will he go in the name of love?
episodes.title: Navirou in Love

episodes.synopsis: Dan has doubts about whether he should be leading the Riders in training, and remembers his old friend Silva, who was once a shoo-in to be the leader.
episodes.title: DSZ (Dan and Silva`s Zeal!)

episodes.synopsis: In the latest ill omen, the village's beneficial wind turns violent. Hyoro struggles to live up to the expectations of his demanding brother Genie.
episodes.title: Portent of Disaster

episodes.synopsis: Lilia leads her friends into the woods to investigate the evil changes taking place. There they learn about a legendary Rider and about Lute's folks.
episodes.title: Before the Storm

episodes.synopsis: A Blight-mad Nargacuga attacks the village, leaving a trail of blind destruction in its wake as Riders young and old do all they can to drive it away.
episodes.title: Invasion of the Nargacuga

episodes.synopsis: There's no time to clean up after the Nargacuga when it could attack the village again at any moment. Cheval swears revenge and takes a new Monstie.
episodes.title: A Lioleia Is Born!

episodes.synopsis: The apprentice Riders go off on their own to face the Blighted Nargacuga, but it's going to be tough with Lute's Monstie still recovering back home...
episodes.title: Face the Black Blight!

episodes.synopsis: The time has come for the young Riders to venture forth beyond Hakum Village, accompanied by excitement, responsibility, and not a little trepidation.
episodes.title: The Journey Begins

episodes.synopsis: Having started their journey outside the village, Lute and Navirou get separated from the others, and find a girl who is hurt and in need of help.
episodes.title: Avinia`s Secret

episodes.synopsis: Lute, Navirou, and Avinia encounter an enigmatic, riddle-loving innkeeper who stands between them and the help Avinia needs for her beloved Monstie.
episodes.title: Meet the Riddlemaster

episodes.synopsis: Lute and friends are dazzled by the big city, but they soon get down to business: finding the Scriveners and a way to keep the Black Blight in check.
episodes.title: Welcome to Gildegaran

episodes.synopsis: It's questing time in the Hunter city of Gildegaran! A task that looks like a piece of cake winds up being more than Lute and Navirou bargained for.
episodes.title: Nerscylla Blitz!

episodes.synopsis: Lute and Lilia stumble across a Felyne village while searching for a Kinship Ore. Navirou is confronted by a strange Felyne who insists they're pals.
episodes.title: The Legend of Pawpad Place

episodes.synopsis: Lilia brings the young Riders a request from the Scriveners that sends them through a vast desert in search of a solution to the Black Blight problem.
episodes.title: Barroth, Landslide Wyvern

episodes.synopsis: The group meets with Hunter opposition in the Oasum refugee camp. A desert battle with a Blighted monster gets an unexpected (and unwelcome) assist.
episodes.title: Desert Mayday

episodes.synopsis: Dan and the other senior Riders meet up with Lute's party in the desert, where Chief Nolma shares some info that changes the course of their quest.
episodes.title: The Horned Wyvern`s Lament

episodes.synopsis: The rift deepens between fellow Riders Lute and Cheval as their attitudes toward rogue monsters drift further apart. Lute reunites with an old friend.
episodes.title: Sky Wyvern, Land Wyvern

episodes.synopsis: After proving their mettle against the Blighted Diablos near the ruins of Reverto's hometown, the Riders reach an understanding about the road ahead.
episodes.title: Diabolical Diablos, Horned Wyvern

episodes.synopsis: Lute wants the same Monstie as the legendary hero Redan. Debli's teacher seems to know where to find precisely the Monstie Egg he's looking for.
episodes.title: The Mysterious White Dragon

episodes.synopsis: Why does Navirou's head hurt at the very mention of the Dovan Volcano? Lute runs into a couple of troublemakers en route to the next Kinship Ore.
episodes.title: Dovan Volcano Memories

episodes.synopsis: Discarded like so much trash, Navirou happens to reunite with some old friends. If only he could remember them, or the grand plan they had to escape.
episodes.title: Onward, Numbers!

episodes.synopsis: Lute and the Numbers face off against Dr. Manelger in his subterranean lab, where the mad scientist has an unpleasant mechanized surprise for them.
episodes.title: The Dragon in the Sea of Fire

episodes.synopsis: Bent on destroying Blighted monsters, Cheval confronts Lute over his beloved Monstie Ratha, who may not even have the strength to defend himself.
episodes.title: Parting Ways

episodes.synopsis: Lute and Reverto track a monster into a mine (despite rumors that it's haunted). Whatever they find, what's more worrying is what finds THEM.
episodes.title: Be the Forest, Be the Beast

episodes.synopsis: There's a Blighted monster on Naubaka Island, but no one who sails there comes back. Lute and friends brave the waves with the unique Bandit Captain.
episodes.title: All-Out Airborne Assault!

episodes.synopsis: Lute and Avinia must defend Koapni Village from the Blighted monster that's been terrorizing the island. Pansy has a big favor to ask Navirou.
episodes.title: The Wolf Raven Strikes Back

episodes.synopsis: Chief Mallerie's pickle weight has been stolen! Never fear: Detective Navirou is on the case. Meanwhile, Lute searches for Naubaka's Kinship Ore.
episodes.title: Rainbow Beach Blockade!

episodes.synopsis: Lilia has a strong lead on the whereabouts of the legendary white dragon's egg, that sends Lute and friends into the ruins of the hero Redan's village.
episodes.title: The White Dragon`s Egg

episodes.synopsis: Lute follows a tip from the Scriveners to outside Albrachs Village. When he tracks down Dr. Manelger, he gets a Hunter's help (headache).
episodes.title: The Great Manelger Chase

episodes.synopsis: A second Kinship Ore in Hakum Village? Lute returns to his hometown just in time to deal with the devastating fallout of the mad Manelger's meddling.
episodes.title: Trouble Returns to Hakum

episodes.synopsis: Cheval is back in Hakum Village! He may be too late to slay the Blighted beast, but he sticks around to confront and challenge his former friend Lute.
episodes.title: The Little Bouquet

episodes.synopsis: Chief Omna brings Lute to the Tower of Illusion, where he undergoes a tense trial meant to dispel the doubt from his mind and lead him to the truth.
episodes.title: Tested at the Tower of Illusion

episodes.synopsis: Lute accompanies Reverto on a quest to slay Brachydios the Destroyer, an ultra-powerful tempered monster and the expert Hunter's longtime rival.
episodes.title: Brachydios the Destroyer

episodes.synopsis: Before Ceval and his team head to the desert to find a Black Diablos running amok, Cheval takes an unexpected (and hopefully more obedient) new Monstie.
episodes.title: The Nargacuga Returns

episodes.synopsis: Lute and Navirou reunite with the Numbers as they search for another Kinship Ore on Mt. Rhyz, where some unexpected company puts their plans on hold.
episodes.title: Numbers, Assemble!

episodes.synopsis: Some familiar faces rejoin Lute on his journey into the Forest of Confusion, hot on the trail of the next Kinship Ore. But the Blight is spreading...
episodes.title: Forest of Confusion

episodes.synopsis: The team has a rare encounter with a mysterious Elder Dragon deep in the Forest of Confusion as they continue their search for the Kinship Ore.
episodes.title: A Mystical Meeting with Kirin

episodes.synopsis: The final Kinship Ore waits amid freezing mountain ruins. Lute and Manelger are in hot pursuit, but Cheval's new Mechinship Stone changes everything.
episodes.title: The Deviljho of Mt. Celion

episodes.synopsis: Cheval flexes his newfound muscle with his white dragon Monstie, but even he's not safe from the Black Blight. Lute seeks a chance to patch things up.
episodes.title: The Legendary White Dragon Is Born!

episodes.synopsis: Lute and Cheval face the staggeringly powerful Black Dread, a monster capable of wiping entire villages off the map; Ratha has a fight of his own.
episodes.title: This Is It: The Black Dread

episodes.synopsis: Lute and Ratha's pitched battle with the formidable Black Dread rages on, but Lute's secret weapon (the power of Kinship) may finally turn the tide.
episodes.title: A Miracle in White

episodes.synopsis: It is fleeting that the world became peaceful, lutes who know that Ayuria was taken away. It seems that the name of the person who took him was Black Riders. It was a lute who tried to rescue Ayuria from them ...
episodes.title: Attack of the Ebon Riders!

episodes.synopsis:
The Mystery of Mamo, also known as The Secret of Mamo, is a 1978 Japanese animated science fiction action comedy film; it is the first animated film of the Lupin III franchise created by manga author Monkey Punch. The film was originally released in Japan as Lupin III (ルパン三世, Rupan Sansei) but was later retitled to Lupin III: Lupin vs. the Clone (ルパン三世 ルパンVS複製人間クローン, Rupan Sansei: Rupan tai Kurōn) to differentiate it from other elements of the franchise. Directed by Sōji Yoshikawa from a screenplay by Yoshikawa and cult pink film screenwriter Atsushi Yamatoya, the film was produced by animation studio Tokyo Movie Shinsha and distributed by Toho. 

The film's plot follows master thief Arsène Lupin III, who attempts to foil Mamo ― a wealthy and powerful recluse seeking immortality ― while trying to win the affections of his rival and would-be lover, Fujiko Mine.

episodes.synopsis: 遠い未来か、はたまた過去かどうかもわからない時代……。さる惑星の地軸が大きく歪む原因不明の大異変により文明社会は消滅し、惑星全土の約90％近くが砂漠化していた。そんな世界のある村で一つの問題が生じていた。村長の孫娘であるアウンが、亜楽器の公演をしに来た吟遊詩人に一目惚れをし、村の宝を持ち出して彼を追いかけて行ってしまったのだ。村長に彼女を連れ戻すように頼まれたフォトンは、なんとかアウンから村の宝を取り戻すことに成功するが連れ戻すことはできず、逆に彼女の亜法で『宝の谷』の谷底へと落とされてしまうハメに！そこでフォトンは奇妙で巨大な鉄の塊を発見する。それは700年もの昔、この地に墜落したキーネの宇宙船の残骸であった……。

episodes.synopsis: 額の紋様は夫婦の証ぃ！知らぬとは言え結婚してしまったフォトンとキーネ。一方、恋の我が道を突き進むアウンはというと……。あっと言う間に振られてしまい、天国から地獄へ真っ逆さま！ガックシ肩を落としているその前に現れたのが、キーネを捕まえるためにこの『砂の惑星』に降り立ったパパチャであった。偶然とは言うものの利害関係がバッチシ合ったアウンとパパチャは、フォトンとキーネを追いかけ始める。果たして、縺れた糸は縺れっぱなしか？フォトンとキーネの新婚初夜は一体どーなる？それは見てのお楽しみ！
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: 『砂の惑星』までキーネを追ってきたパパチャを撃退し、キーネのお爺ちゃんの亜法記憶体を捜す旅（新婚旅行とも言う……）を続けるフォトンとキーネ。そこには行きがかり上なんとなくついて来たアウンもいた。お腹を空かせた旦那様（フォトン）に料理を作る新婚気分のキーネがどうも面白くないアウン。そこで、二人の意地とプライドをかけた世紀の料理対決の火蓋が切って落とされる！はたして空腹のフォトンは無事にゴハンを食べることが出来るのか？そして、パパチャを追いかけるために旅立ったラシャラ皇女の行く先に待つ運命や……いかに！？それは見てのおたのしみ～。
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: キーネ略奪失敗の責任を押しつけられ、パパチャに見捨てられてしまったポチ1号。異郷の砂漠を一人彷徨ってる途中、突如としてサンドスネークに襲われる。その絶体絶命危機を救ったのは空腹でクラクラ状態なフォトンであった。ポチ1号を見捨てたパパチャ様御一行は、ある温泉宿で飲めや歌えの大暴れ！そこにポチ1号を交えたフォトンたちがやって来た。ここぞとばかりにキーネ捕獲の罠をはるパパチャ！一方、パパチャを追って『砂の惑星』に来たラシャラ皇女たちも合流し物語は怒濤の急展開をむかえる！！果たしてフォトンはパパチャの魔の手からキーネたちを守れるのか!?それは見てのお楽しみ～。
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: いよいよ物語は終盤戦！謎が謎よぶ展開の中、あこがれのアウンの姉と感動の対面を果たし、幸せを体一杯にかみしめているフォトンくん。一方、ついに不穏な行動をとるブランがパパチャに接触！！怪しい探り合いが続くなか、パパチャはラシャラの一途な想いを利用してフォトンたち一行を罠にハメようと画策する。再会を祝す宴会で「鬼の汲み湯」の事を聞いたキーネは、そこが自分の探している亜法記憶体がある場所と結論つけ早速、探すために出かけるが……そして特異点＆銀が結界炉とは？……それは見てのお楽しみ～。
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: パパチャの追っ手から逃れ『砂の星』にたどり着いたキーネが、この地で不思議な（亜法を中和させる）力を持つ少年フォトン・アースと出会うことからこの物語は始まる……ひょんな事からフォトンのお嫁さんとなってしまうキーネ。さらにフォトンの幼なじみアウンを巻き込んで、嬉し恥ずかしの新婚旅行（本当は亜法記憶体を探す旅）が始まった。そこに、キーネを追って来たパパチャとその一行が加わり物語はクライマックスへ！ついにパパチャの手中に落ちたキーネを助けるためフォトンは果敢に立ち向かうが、思わぬ反亜法攻撃に大苦戦を強いられる。はたしてフォトンは無事キーネを救出しハッピーエンドを迎えられるのか!?全ての謎と驚愕の事実を集約し、ついに迎えた最終話!!果たしてその結末は……？それは見てのお楽しみ～
episodes.title: Episodio 6

info.synopsis: Photon Earth è un ragazzo giovane e gentile dotato di una forza sovrumana e della scritta "Baka" (che significa "idiota" in giapponese) scarabocchiato sulla fronte (apparentemente dall'amica combinaguai Aun Freya). Un giorno, si ritrova fidanzato con la bella pilota latitante Keyne Acqua dopo aver scritto "baka" sulla fronte. E questa è l'ultima delle sue preoccupazioni, perché deve proteggere sia Aun che Keyne dal malvagio Papacharino, che vuole rubare i segreti di "Aho" (un'altra parola per dire "idiota"), l'energia dalla nave del nonno di Keyne.
info.title: Photon: The Idiot Adventures

episodes.synopsis: Sae Iwata è una ragazza un po' robusta per la sua età. Il suo amore, Koki Kamishiro, un tempo delicato e fragile, in terza media è diventato un giovane affascinante e popolare. Dopo anni di silenzio, i suoi sentimenti non sono cambiati. Quando i due fanno coppia per organizzare il festival dello sport, il primo amore di Sae, rimasto a lungo assopito, ricomincia a germogliare.
episodes.title: Il giorno in cui ho allungato la mano

episodes.synopsis: Sae e Kamishiro finiscono nella stessa classe alle medie. Durante un incarico di raccolta della spazzatura a cui partecipano insieme, Kamishiro litiga con un compagno. Quando Sae si fa avanti, lui instintivamente la chiama col suo nome, riaprendo una finestra sui vecchi ricordi. Nel frattempo, anche un'altra ragazza, Hisui, sembra essere attratta da Kamishiro.
episodes.title: Chiamami per nome

episodes.synopsis: Sapere che Kamishiro ha una cotta per una persona affligge Sae. Tuttavia, durante una gita scolastica, Sae si ritrova incapace di togliergli gli occhi di dosso. Le sue amiche, Hisui e Kagawa, fanno del loro meglio per aiutarla, ma Sae finisce sempre per mostrare il suo lato più impacciato in presenza di Kamishiro.
episodes.title: Malgrado la distanza

episodes.synopsis: Kamishiro ammette a Sae di provare dei sentimenti per qualcuno, descrivendo la sua cotta come "una stella che brilla più luminosa del sole". Parole che trafiggono il cuore di Sae, ma lei sceglie comunque di sostenerlo. Tuttavia, mentre Kamishiro continua a trattarla come al solito, Sae si ritrova divisa tra i suoi sentimenti e la sua determinazione.
episodes.title: Anche quando chiudo gli occhi, tu ci sei

episodes.synopsis: Dopo la gita scolastica, le classi si sfideranno in un torneo di salto con la corda, e Sae e Kamishiro vengono scelti per far oscillare la corda. Nonostante l'accoppiamento inaspettato, Sae cerca di non fissarsi troppo su Kamishiro. All'inizio delle prove, le cose non vanno lisce come previsto. Un pomeriggio dopo la scuola, Sae vede Kagawa che si esercita da sola dietro la scuola.
episodes.title: Saltando e dondolando

episodes.synopsis: Sae si prende un giorno libero dalla scuola. Il giorno dopo, Kamishiro si fa male durante l'allenamento della squadra e anche lui si prende un giorno di riposo. Quando si prestano i quaderni per recuperare le lezioni perse, i due iniziano a scambiarsi messaggi. Un piccolo incidente porta Kamishiro a scoprire che a Sae piace qualcuno. Ignaro dei suoi veri sentimenti, la incoraggia a provarci.
episodes.title: Cervello, cuore e coraggio

episodes.synopsis: Kamishiro viene selezionato fra i membri principali del cast per lo spettacolo teatrale del Festival dell'Inglese. In difficoltà con questa lingua, si rivolge a Sae per chiederle aiuto. Mentre provano, i due si promettono di vedere un film insieme durante le vacanze estive. Il giorno del festival, l'esibizione della classe procede senza intoppi fino a quando Sae irrompe improvvisamente sul palco.
episodes.title: Pioggia a ciel sereno

episodes.synopsis: Con gli eventi scolastici ormai alle spalle, Sae si butta nelle attività del club. Proprio in quel momento, viene fissata la data per la tanto attesa uscita al cinema con Kamishiro. Tuttavia, un incontro casuale con la cugina di Kamishiro, Subaru, lascia Sae a disagio, poiché le torna in mente una cosa che Kamishiro ha detto una volta riguardo alla sua cotta.
episodes.title: Dieci anni

episodes.synopsis: Dopo il loro appuntamento al cinema, Sae si rende conto ancora una volta che a meno che non esprima i suoi sentimenti, Kamishiro non li noterà mai. Dopo avere appreso da Hisui che la festa scolastica è il momento ideale per le confessioni d'amore, decide di dirglielo all'after-party. Mentre si prepara, Sae trova il dipinto di Subaru vandalizzato e le circostanze fanno sembrare lei la colpevole.
episodes.title: I sentimenti di qualcuno

episodes.synopsis: Mentre procedono i preparativi per lo spettacolo scolastico, Sae cerca di parlare con Kamishiro, ma non sembra mai il momento giusto per farlo. Come se non bastasse, Hisui rivela di aver trascorso la maggior parte del tempo in compagnia di Ayukawa. Proprio quando Sae decide di essere più proattiva, Kamishiro fa una proposta inaspettata.
episodes.title: Voci

episodes.synopsis: Preoccupata per Subaru, Sae si reca in infermiera. Lì, Kamishiro nota che Subaru cerca di comportarsi bene, e così si offre di aiutarla durante la festa scolastica. Sae sente una fitta di solitudine, poiché aveva programmato di confessargli i suoi sentimenti in quell'occasione. Tuttavia, Kamishiro chiarisce che non sarà disponibile durante il suo turno alla reception con Sae.
episodes.title: Una stella senza costellazione

episodes.synopsis: Dopo aver sentito che Kamishiro ha intenzione di dichiararsi alla persona che gli piace, Sae confessa impulsivamente i suoi sentimenti. Sopraffatta dall'emozione, scappa, convinta di essere stata rifiutata. Si nasconde nel ripostiglio della palestra, piangendo fino a quando la porta si apre lentamente e appare Kamishiro.
episodes.title: A Star Brighter Than the Sun

info.synopsis: Sae Iwata è una ragazza più grande della media che prova timidezza per la sua altezza mentre il suo amico d'infanzia Koki, che da piccolo era gracile, crescendo è diventato un bel ragazzo. La ragazza pensava si fossero allontanati, ma durante l'ultimo festival sportivo delle medie si sono riuniti. Ora, arrivati alle superiori, Sae si rende conto di provare dei sentimenti per lui ma anche di non essere l'unica ad essere interessata all'amico. La vera domanda è una sola... per chi prova sentimenti Koki?
info.title: A Star Brighter Than the Sun (ITA)

episodes.synopsis: Oji Tanaka starts the day by losing his beloved "Flying V" guitar twice because his wife wants to get rid of it. At work his boss harries him. Later, after work, he believes he is being seduced by his new coworker (an alien in disguise).
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: The next morning, Tanaka's son Gen accidentally destroys his prized autographed LP record by his idol Michael Schenker, and his wife is shown to be entirely unmoved by his loss. At work, Tanaka believes that his "stairway to heaven" experience from the night before was not a dream.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Spurred by busybody rumormongering neighbors, Yoshiko's suspicion that Oji is cheating on her grows, though she tries to suppress it. It did not help matters that she spots Oji with Layla.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Oji reluctantly babysits his son Gen because Yoshiko is going to her high school reunion, but feels compelled to play his guitar at the model house, leaving Gen behind in his haste.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Oji feels re-energized and dresses in his old rock outfits (blond wig, leather jacket, and leather pants, which he can't button anymore because he's gained weight) in an attempt to revive his rocker identity as "Gabriel."
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: Oji is in a funk because he's decided to quit music. Alien Chief Scientist Hamill vows to do anything she can to have Oji play again. Meanwhile, Kotoko, Eriko, and Rinko try various futile methods to "inspire" Oji,
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: The aliens are under increasing attacks from their enemies. Hamill tries to persuade Oji to play music, and he seems receptive by playing twice. However, the ultimate weapon mysteriously does not fire properly.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Oji invites his surviving former bandmates from Black Heaven, Sato/Michael, Yamada/Luke, and Suzuki/Raphael for drinks. They reminisce about the old times and Oji tells him about the alien war and his music weapon.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Oji attempts to recruit members for his new band, the New Black Heaven, and has his son Gen draw the "space attitude" recruitment poster.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: Black Heaven, and by extension the ultimate weapon, is not at full power because it is missing its keyboardist Watanabe/Joseph.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: The rival aliens are perfecting their own final weapon using a clone of Watanabe's corpse.
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: The rival aliens test their ultimate weapon "Biomechanical Android Watanabe", which has 6 arms and can play 3 keyboards simultaneously, and almost destroy the aliens, canceling out Black Heaven.
episodes.title: Episodio 12

episodes.synopsis: 1999 The final battle begins, and Black Heaven plays a marathon session in their struggle against the Watanabe clone.
episodes.title: Episodio 13

info.synopsis: Tutti nella nostra vita abbiamo avuto almeno un sogno, al quale, come spesso accade, siamo stati costretti a rinunciare. Il sogno di Oji Tanaka era diventare una grande rock star. 15 anni fa era conosciuto come Gabe, il leader di un gruppo heavy metal chiamato Black Heaven e tutto sembrava andare alla grande... Ma si sa, spesso la vita non va come ci si aspetta. Costretto ad abbandonare il proprio sogno, oggi Oji Tanaka è un uomo di mezza età con una moglie, un figlio in tenera età e un noioso lavoro da impiegato. La sua vita gli sembra scorrere lenta e monotona se paragonata allo splendore di quei giorni. Ma il destino ha in serbo altro per lui. Riuscirà questo eroico padre di famiglia, accompagnato dalla sua fedele Flying V, a salvare l'universo con la sua musica?
info.title: Legend of Black Heaven

info.synopsis: Nell'anno 1999 ha inizio un invasione da parte degli Ideliani che intendono conquistare la Terra. Le forze difensive terrestri non possono competere con le potenze nemiche, tuttavia c'è un'unità conosciuta con il nome di Tokusou Kihei Dorvack, che dimostra di essere in grado di infliggere ingenti danni all'invasore. Makoto Mugen, Pierre Bonaparte, Louise Oberon e il colonnello Takashiro combatteranno il nemico grazie all'utilizzo di particolari robot.
info.title: Special Powered Armor Troop Dorvack

episodes.synopsis: Mysteriously transformed in a kid, legendary hitman Juzo poses as a student to investigate a middle school. Later, he encounters a suspicious intruder.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Juzo discovers Mitsuoka Pharmaceuticals created the wasp and befriends the president's aloof daughter Noren. As he slowly befriends her, she's kidnapped.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Juzo turns to a classmate to catch up on his studies and joins the home economics club with Noren. Mitsuoka Pharmaceuticals makes a big announcement.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Juzo's cover as Noren's boyfriend comes under fire when a young assassin transfers in and challenges Juzo to a duel in a bid to become Noren's fiancé.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: While on an errand, the Home Economics Club runs into Tenma, a brash multi-sport ace who challenges Juzo to a futsal match. Will Juzo take him on?
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: Juzo and Tenma’s futsal showdown begins. With his astonishing physical ability, Tenma overwhelms the Home Ec Club team of Juzo, Shin, and Kito. Sensing that Juzo is no ordinary opponent, Tenma drops the handicap and starts playing for real. Juzo and the others fight desperately to keep up with Tenma’s dominant performance, but how will the match end?
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: Juzo and Noren end up on a double date with Chisato and Tenma. The four enjoy shopping and lunch, but the moment the movie starts, Juzo mysteriously reverts to his adult body! He rushes to the restroom, only for Noren to be kidnapped again. Chasing the culprit’s car to a stadium, Juzo and Tenma face Kazuma and Eiji Rindou, assassin brothers from the industry’s top organization, JARDIN.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Kazuma wields powerful hypnosis, while Eiji launches a brutal assault with explosive golf balls. They, too, are assassins chasing Mitsuoka Pharmaceutical’s secrets. Juzo struggles as Kazuma turns civilians against him. And Kazuma has already placed a certain hypnotic spell on Noren. To save her, Juzo races to her side...
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Juzo races to Noren’s side. Meanwhile, Tenma and Eiji clash in an outrageous soccer-vs.-explosive-golf battle. Tenma prepares to end the fight with a move he developed in practice. But at the end of the life-or-death struggle against Kazuma and Eiji, the unconscious Noren awakens, and the first thing she sees is...
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: After Kazuma’s hypnosis makes Noren fall deeply for Juzo, she launches an all-out attack on his heart. But when Juzo gently turns her down, she tries to jump from the roof! Desperate to undo the spell, Juzo takes Noren to meet Kazuma at an amusement park, only to end up alone with her on a Ferris wheel, where things take a dangerously romantic turn?!
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: With more assassins gathering at school, Ogami organizes the first-ever Hitman Summit in hopes of keeping everyone under control. However, the meeting quickly descends into chaos as the eccentric personalities clash. Meanwhile, a heated ramen challenge draws unexpected attention, and a mysterious girl makes a surprising appearance that may change everything.
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: Unicorn Mai Otohime is a marine-sports prodigy with expert-level ocean knowledge. She has come for a Mitsuoka Duel too, but her target is Juzo. This leads to Noren challenging Mai herself. As the duel nears, Juzo and the others face parent-teacher conferences and questions about their futures, leading Juzo to reflect on his school life, the friends he’s made, and the possibilities ahead.
episodes.title: Episodio 12

info.synopsis: Jūzō Ōgami è un leggendario sicario che non ha mai fallito una missione, per quanto impossibile potesse sembrare. Un giorno, dopo aver eliminato una potente organizzazione, viene punto da una misteriosa vespa e perde conoscenza. Al suo risveglio, il temibile assassino trentanovenne si ritrova trasformato in un ragazzino di 13 anni! Prima ancora di riuscire a capire cosa sia successo, il suo capo gli affida un nuovo incarico: "Infiltrati in una scuola media con quel corpo." Quello che lo attende è una vita scolastica del tutto inaspettata, piena di compagni eccentrici, caos adolescenziale e pericoli in agguato. Riuscirà Jūzō a tornare alla sua forma originale? O gli assassini che gli stanno dando la caccia metteranno fine alla sua seconda vita prima ancora che inizi davvero!?
info.title: Kill Blue (ITA)

info.synopsis: La protagonista è Yotsugi Ononoki, personaggio della Monogatari Series, che viene reinterpretata come una magical girl. La storia comincia quando Tsukihi Araragi scopre Yotsugi mentre mangia il gelato dopo essere tornata prima da scuola. Yotsugi le rivela di essere una magical girl. Tsukihi decide quindi di diventare a sua volta una magical girl e Yotsugi chiede aiuto a Nadeko Sengoku per preparare il costume e il relativo oggetto magico.

info.synopsis: Karna è un ragazzo che vive una vita normale, finché l'antico demone Kalimba si libera e porta la sua corruzione nel mondo. Quando l'oscurità infetta sua madre, si risvegliano i poteri di Karna, si scopre così la sua vera identità: il Compensatore, un Guardiano nato per ripristinare l'armonia nel mondo. Per salvare sua madre e fermare il caos portato da Kalimba, Karna dovrà allenarsi per padroneggiare il suo potere interiore o rischia di perdere tutto.
info.title: Karna the Guardian
